# Retinalinks — Premier Digital Agency & Top Website Development Company

> Retinalinks is a world-class digital agency and bespoke website development company engineering high-performance web applications, enterprise websites, and scalable digital design systems for ambitious brands worldwide.

## Company Overview
- **Name**: Retinalinks
- **Legal Name**: Retinalinks Digital Agency
- **Website**: https://retinalinks.com
- **Core Industry**: Digital Agency, Website Development, Web Application Engineering, UI/UX Design, AI Solutions
- **Delivery Model**: Global / Worldwide async delivery (North America, Europe, Asia, Global)
- **Primary Tech Stack**: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Tailwind CSS, Vanilla CSS, Framer Motion
- **Performance Standard**: 99+ Core Web Vitals, sub-second load times, zero-template bespoke architecture
- **Inquiries**: https://retinalinks.com/contact | contact@retinalinks.com

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Website Development (Custom & Enterprise)
- Custom corporate and marketing websites with sub-second load times
- Next.js server-side rendering (SSR), static site generation (SSG), and incremental regeneration (ISR)
- Responsive, mobile-first, and WCAG AA accessibility compliance
- Search Engine Optimization (SEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) architecture
- Enterprise CMS integrations and headless architecture

### 2. Custom Web Application Development
- Bespoke SaaS platforms, customer portals, and internal business tools
- Full-stack TypeScript architecture with PostgreSQL and Supabase real-time backends
- Robust API design, secure authentication (NextAuth, Supabase Auth), and role-based access control
- Scalable cloud deployments on Vercel and AWS

### 3. UI/UX Product Design & Systems
- User research, wireframing, high-fidelity Figma prototyping
- Custom design token systems and reusable component libraries
- Fluid micro-interactions, 3D interactive product displays, and motion choreography
- Conversion rate optimization (CRO) grounded design patterns

### 4. Native & Cross-Platform Mobile Apps
- High-performance mobile applications for iOS and Android
- Offline-first architectures, real-time push notifications, and ergonomic touch UX

### 5. Brand Identity & Visual Strategy
- Comprehensive brand guidelines, vector logos, typography hierarchies, and chromatic palettes
- Cohesive digital presence from emblem design to enterprise design systems

## Flagship Work & Proven Case Studies
- **StaffEarn** (https://staffearn.com): AI Staffing & Premium IT Recruitment Platform connecting top-tier talent with tech leaders. High-conversion candidate matching engine with automated workflows.
- **HealthTrack Pro**: Enterprise clinical analytics & telemedicine portal handling real-time telemetry, HIPAA-aligned architecture, and actionable health dashboards.
- **StudioFlow**: Collaborative workspace application for distributed creative teams with real-time kanban tracking and version control.
- **Auxano**: Modern wealth management and FinTech analytics platform featuring interactive financial charting and institutional security.
